description: This file implements system notification handling for an Android app, including posting notifications, managing notification channels based on priority, and parsing JSON request parameters.

classes.name: SystemNotifyRequest
classes.description: Data class representing a request to show a system notification, including title, body, sound, and priority.

classes.name: SystemNotificationPoster
classes.description: Interface defining methods to check authorization and post notifications.

classes.name: AndroidSystemNotificationPoster
classes.description: Android-specific implementation of SystemNotificationPoster, handling notification permission checks and posting.

classes.name: SystemHandler
classes.description: Main class that manages notification requests, including parsing JSON parameters, authorization checks, and delegating the posting.

methods.name: isAuthorized
methods.description: Checks whether the app has permission to post notifications.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Posts a system notification based on the provided request.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify
methods.description: Main handler method that processes JSON input, checks authorization, and attempts to post the notification.

methods.name: parseNotifyRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON string into a SystemNotifyRequest object.

methods.name: parseParamsObject
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into a JsonObject.

methods.name: ensureChannel
methods.description: Ensures a notification channel with the specified priority exists, creates one if necessary.

methods.name: compatPriority
methods.description: Converts priority string to Android notification priority constant.

methods.name: isSilentSound
methods.description: Determines if the sound setting indicates silence.
